dt-api.name: stateRestore.state().load()
dt-api.summary: Load a state from StateRestore into the table

type.description: Loads the selected state in the DataTable and draws it.
type.returns: Returns a DataTables API instance for chaining.

dt-api.description: Once you have states in StateRestore, you'll want to provide the end user with the ability to have the table re-take that state, so they can return to it when selected. This method provides that ability by taking the selected state, loading it into the table (`-api state()`) and then drawing the table.
